rows.contract: External backend dependencies are linked only when the existing backend gate is enabled.
rows.native_mapping: Retain existing guard for non-native targets; add no Vulkan, loader or MoltenVK to the native frontend graph.
rows.expected_result: Native compile database, build graph and final linked symbols have no prohibited backend runtime. Disable legacy Vulkan in off verification as well.
rows.actual_result: Actual native/off Qt graph, one native ARC bridge and single linked symbol, Qt core renderer-independent dependency closure, native app link, offscreen target rejection, PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: Apple layer helper is a frontend concern. Existing other Apple configurations retain the existing source graph.
rows.native_mapping: Give the native Metal Qt bridge a single citra_qt compilation and keep old Qt helper target registration for feature-off Apple builds.
rows.expected_result: Only one Objective-C++ ARC object for native Qt, feature-off registration unchanged and native renderer independent of Qt.
rows.actual_result: Actual native/off Qt graph, one native ARC bridge and single linked symbol, Qt core renderer-independent dependency closure, native app link, offscreen target rejection, PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: Existing Apple Qt window-system helper is shared by existing configurations. Preserve its source registration and backend option guards.
rows.native_mapping: Link QuartzCore directly to the existing Apple feature-off Qt path. Keep the native bridge private and ARC-managed, and preserve the software renderer and shared window helper.
rows.expected_result: Both arm64 Qt executables link. Software-only has QuartzCore with no Metal, MetalFX, Vulkan or MoltenVK direct link. Native still has one ARC bridge and all required native frameworks. PICA/CTest pass in both configurations.
rows.actual_result: Software-only link failed with unresolved _OBJC_CLASS_$_CAMetalLayer. Production correction is pending.
